+# 设计
+
+以最小范围修复同一轮已确认的 Skill 适用性与方法精度。入口/参考文字优先替换、合并既有句子；不放宽 Profile 阈值或新增方法框架。
+
+## 所有权与实现
+
+- routing implementer：既有 canonical matcher/manifest/单测 Skill 适用范围与定向正反回归。先检查路由与直接 skill-trigger 两条入口，不用语言黑名单。
+- method implementer：perf、storage、production pilot、artifact、growth、composition、URL 的既有入口/参考修正；从验收派生最小确定性方法与导出/命令检查。
+- Root preparer：只读核 Root 当前晋级流程和证据格式；ADK 不可变 Release 完成后再接入。
+- coordinator：需求/设计/任务、版本包装、回归整合、原始证据及发布；独立只读 reviewer 不改实现。
+
+公共路由行为需实际 matcher 正反控；导出依赖用真实 compiler 的 team-core 两种输出检查；扫描用真实 rg 覆盖。纯措辞更正可用范围案例核对，不能仅靠关键词存在声称行为改善。URL/UBI 的方法控制只证明各自失败条件，不声称实际生产客户端/设备实验。
+
+路由所需领域词优先放入既有 Skill frontmatter 的可选 implicit_context；由同一 canonical kernel 统一消费并校验类型。没有该字段的旧 Skill 保持语义；不在 Python 维护第二份 Skill/领域词表，不增加平行 IR。局部否定、显式域外和正常多句嵌入式任务都须有对照。
+
+## 验证与体积
+
+受影响共享路由/manifest 按仓库要求执行完整回归；先定向验证以定位失败。独立复审绑定具体 source tree、变更文件和 fresh 证据。原 8 个 ratchet 是源增长约束，不是实测 Token。任何失败先保留原始结果再判断。
+
+## 发布与回滚
+
+候选 patch 版本预期 11.3.13，包装前重新确认版本。使用当前受保护 PR、main exact-SHA 自动发布链；Root 仅消费已核验不可变发布，更新真实 submodule/lock/晋级证据，不变更历史资格。回滚使用前一不可变 11.3.12 与 Root 精确指针；不覆盖旧 tag/release。
+
+已核 Root 当前实现是 source-only 两路径事务：仅提交 agent-dev-kit Gitlink 与 reports/current-status.md 自动投影；adk.lock 是忽略缓存，native Release attestation 由既有 integration-deep 验证，不复制旧式 promotion/M5 材料。

+# 方法范围核对（实现者记录）
+
+本记录不是独立 review 或宿主行为认证；最终独立审核由其他 reviewer 执行。针对 7 项修正核对保留的语义与反例：
+
+| 项目 | 方法/源级验收 | 保留的边界 |
+|---|---|---|
+| perf | ARM PMUv3 的通用 CACHE_MISSES 映射为 L1D_CACHE_REFILL，故不得通称 LLC。入口现在按 CPU/PMU/运行内核映射解释，LLC 结论核专用事件，未知/不支持 unavailable。 | 正确采样、有效负载、等价工作量 A/B、噪声/扰动、无效与无收益仍区分；未测具体 BSP。 |
+| artifact | 实际 compiler 将 team-core 导出为 claude-code、opencode；随包参考限定 llm_agent Root helper，普通消费者沿用已核验项目门禁。 | Root 接入仍核适用 helper；缺适用门禁 BLOCKED；无新脚本或安装依赖。 |
+| composition | 实际执行发布命令，对照 manifest 的完整 core/optional 路径集合，包含两个嵌套子 Skill。 | 沿用 rg；未改变 canonical matcher、安装器或权限。 |
+| growth | frontmatter 和正文均将 trace 候选限定为持久 prompt/Skill/Workflow/AGENTS/记忆晋级；普通建议不需晋级。 | 实际写操作按原任务授权；长期资产仍为候选、审核与验证，不自动保存记忆。 |
+| URL | 若 DNS 预检公网、连接前解析变内网，连接只能使用已核地址；重试/fallback 同样受限，重定向重核。 | 原 hostname 的 Host/SNI/证书校验保留；工具不能兑现时沿用无法安全检查即停止。未新增 HTTP 客户端或宣称实网绕过已修。 |
+| UBI/UBIFS | 逻辑 layout/hash 相同但 VID/data offset 与目标不符，仍不可交设备；对齐 PEB、min-I/O/subpage、VID/data offset、LEB、volume 对齐/容量。 | 仅相应格式启用；未知留 host；原备份/恢复、operator、readback/boot、单板后扩批边界保留。 |
+| human-active | 两人区间 [0,15]、[5,20] 的并集为 20 分钟、合计 30 人分钟；分别记录，不混用不等式或基线口径。 | 单人即并集，无额外多人字段；agent-active 仍为各 Agent 时长之和，不能冒充 wall-clock。 |
+
+## 可追溯来源
+
+- Linux v6.12 ARM PMUv3 映射：https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/drivers/perf/arm_pmuv3.c#L48 （blob 0afe02f879b45a8600b9cea1bfd88e6a68096a67）；LL cache read miss 在第 72 行单列。
+- Linux v6.12 UBI 目标偏移校验：https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.12/drivers/mtd/ubi/io.c#L658 （blob a4999bce435f5618986dc9b96f973cf4e64676c0）；data offset 在第 664 行另核。
+- OWASP SSRF Prevention：已验证地址须用于连接并保留原 hostname，重试/fallback 同样适用。https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Server_Side_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html
+- Python create_connection 对非数字 hostname 再解析的语义：https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/socket.html#socket.create_connection
+
+以上官方资料已在前轮审查实际读取，本轮不把源码反例冒充实网/板端测量。新 tests 中导出与 rg 为真实执行；perf/growth 检查仅为源条款防回归。
+
+## 交付观察
+
+- 新测试注册在既有 tests/test_skill_content.sh，未新增全局测试套件或门禁。
+- 基线红：red-tests.txt，4 个 test / 5 个失败子项。
+- 语义修正与初次消重后，verified-targeted-tests.txt：43 项通过。
+- 最后一次重复自然语言消重后，handoff-targeted-tests.txt：17 项通过；git diff --check 通过。
+- 当前 9 个入口/参考文件相对基线净减少 69 B，其中 core entry+refs 净减少 195 B；精确文件摘要见 handoff-file-deltas.json。源字节变化不等于实测 Token 收益。
+- profile-ratchets*.json、final-profile-ratchets.json、verified-profile-ratchets.json 是并发编辑期间的原始阶段观察，包含已保留的超限负结果；不作为最终整合资格。最终 8 项由 coordinator 在所有实现冻结后统一核验，原阈值未改。

+
+- 基线：0973b9dce75e7bde289a9915fc58dfd53cb79b0d / 11.3.12。
+- 新增验收回归在改动入口前实际运行，4 个 test、5 个失败子项：perf 通用 LLC 标签、growth 过宽前置条件、rg 漏两个嵌套入口、两种 team-core 导出的 Root helper 条件。原始输出与字节哈希见 red-tests.raw.json；red-tests.txt 为移除行尾空格的展示副本；退出码 1 不计成功。

+- 阅读辅助命令曾假定存在 tests/test_skill_contract_methods.sh；实际只有 Python 模块并由 test_skill_content.sh 注册。改用已存在入口读取，不计产品失败。
+- 所有观察均为源码/确定性方法范围；没有付费模型、真实网络客户端、设备、HIL 或生产率结论。

+# Formatted domain-name regression
+
+Baseline: `3f80b613bf18cd121e3c782cc0a8d69c646f078d`. The independent review found that unconditionally removing inline quotation contents rejected valid MCU, RTOS, Zephyr and embedded host-model targets. This follow-up corrects that false negative without changing the domain vocabulary, Skill entry, manifest, permissions or export contract.
+
+## Red to green
+
+The new `test_embedded_unit_formatted_scope_preserves_task_context` was first run against the baseline implementation. All seven positive subcases failed; the nine negative controls passed. `red-tests.txt` preserves that actual failure. After the fix, `green-tests.txt` records the same method passing, and `matrix-final.txt` records the original 20 methods plus this new method passing (**21/21**).
+
+The independent review's 14-case baseline is preserved in `before.json`, copied verbatim in data from `/workspace/scratch/fe8de3b42084/independent-scope-review/raw/routing-neighbors.stdout.txt`. `after.json` replays those exact prompts through the public matcher: **10/14 → 14/14** expected outcomes. All 14 after-results keep `mutation_permission=deny`. The baseline copy is independent-review evidence; the red test and after replay were executed by the implementer.
+
+## Small format correction
+
+Fenced code remains excluded. Ordinary paired inline backticks and quotation marks now lose only their delimiters, retaining the enclosed technical name. The existing local negation matcher therefore still rejects forms such as `不是` followed by a backtick-wrapped `MCU`, and `not` followed by quoted `embedded`.
+
+A bounded syntax rule still discards quoted content introduced at the start of a clause by `文档写着`, `文档示例`, `示例`, `引述`, `example`, `quote` or `quoted`. This preserves explicit quoted-example negatives without making punctuation alone a reason to reject a real task target. The marker vocabulary describes presentation syntax; domain vocabulary stays in the existing Skill metadata. No target-name list or general background classifier was introduced.
+
+The matcher remains lexical. It does not resolve every unmarked quotation or unrelated background construction, and the runtime Fit/Target gate remains required. Native host behavior and model token effect remain **not-measured**.
+
+## Scope and checks
+
+Changed source files: `_matcher_kernel.py`, `test_skill_trigger_matrix.py`, and the `match` documentation in `docs/commands.md`. The Skill entry remains 3066 bytes and version 1.1.8. No manifest, Profile ratchet, project-version field or permission change was made by this implementer.
+
+Commands ran through `/workspace/scratch/fe5385ca063a/verification-tools/rtk bypass`, with `PYTHONPATH=src:tests` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` for tests:
+
+- New regression method: expected exit 1 before, exit 0 after.
+- Full `python3 -m unittest test_skill_trigger_matrix`: exit 0, 21 tests.
+- Independent 14-prompt replay: exit 0, 14 expected outcomes.
+- `git diff --check`: exit 0.
+
+The coordinator stopped the earlier full regression before these source edits and owns a fresh full regression. This evidence does not claim that the interrupted run qualifies the revised source. No commit or push was performed by this implementer.

+# T1 routing verification
+
+Baseline: `0973b9dce75e7bde289a9915fc58dfd53cb79b0d` (11.3.12). This is implementation evidence from `route_implementation`, not an independent review or a full CI result. The coordinator owns integration validation and final project versioning.
+
+This snapshot predates the independent review's formatted-domain finding. The subsequent correction, current quotation semantics and 21-test result are recorded in `formatted-context/verification.md`; the original before/after artifacts below remain preserved as historical evidence.
+
+## Result
+
+The 12 preserved source counterexamples and positive controls move from 5/12 to 12/12 expected outcomes. Python/pytest with explicit non-embedded scope, generic Rust/cargo, generic unit tests, locally negated scope and quoted context no longer implicitly select `adk-unit-test-embedded`. MCU drivers, embedded Python host models, embedded Rust firmware and host-only execution remain eligible. A split-context request, `MCU 工程；补 UART 单测`, now selects the embedded unit Skill. Every after-probe result retains `mutation_permission=deny`.
+
+`before.json` preserves original results and the baseline Skill hash. `after.json` replays the same prompts through the public matcher. `result.json` records source hashes and byte counts. These are selected deterministic cases; they do not estimate general routing accuracy.
+
+## Implementation and compatibility
+
+- The optional, non-empty `implicit_context` phrase list lives in the existing Skill source. The canonical matcher requires an affirmative domain match for implicit routing, trigger fallback, promoted primaries and secondary primary candidates. No manifest entry, IR schema, Skill inventory, permission ceiling or additional routing layer changed.
+- The existing local polarity matcher is reused. Quoted strings and fenced/inline code do not establish context. Domain and task may appear in different sentences. Explicit out-of-domain wording remains in `non_triggers`.
+- Field absence preserves previous behavior. Empty, scalar, non-string or empty-phrase values fail source validation and implicit consumption. Explicit single-Skill diagnostics retain trigger/non-trigger behavior, including supporting Skills; they do not acquire write permission.
+- Claude Code and OpenCode exports retain their existing frontmatter contract. The new field is not exported as a native host gate. Description and body express the MCU/RTOS plus host-model scope. Native host discovery and actual model token savings are **not-measured**.
+
+The check is lexical: an unquoted, affirmative MCU mention in unrelated background can still satisfy the context condition. The implementation deliberately preserves normal split-sentence descriptions rather than introducing a general background classifier. Explicit task-domain exclusions and runtime Fit/Target gates remain necessary. No claim is made to solve every quoted, multilingual or ambiguous-background construction.
+

+"""Exercise published scan/export paths; source checks do not certify model behavior."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import glob
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+import yaml
+
+from agent_dev_kit.compiler import export_assets
+from agent_dev_kit.model import Manifest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+COMPOSITION = ROOT / "optional-skills/adk-skill-composition-governance/SKILL.md"
+ARTIFACT = ROOT / "skills/adk-artifact-gating/references/details.md"
+
+
+class PublishedSkillScopeMethodsTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_published_trigger_scan_covers_the_manifest_including_nested_skills(self):
+        commands = [line for line in COMPOSITION.read_text().splitlines()
+                    if line.startswith("rg ") and "triggers:" in line]
+        self.assertEqual(1, len(commands))
+        # Expand the shell's glob arguments without interpreting shell operators.
+        arguments = []
+        for argument in shlex.split(commands[0]):
+            matches = glob.glob(argument, root_dir=ROOT) if glob.has_magic(argument) else []
+            arguments.extend(sorted(matches) or [argument])
+        self.assertEqual("rg", arguments[0])
+        observed = subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,
+                                  text=True, timeout=10)
+        self.assertEqual(0, observed.returncode, observed.stderr)
+        paths = {line.split(":", 1)[0] for line in observed.stdout.splitlines()}
+        manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "manifest.json").read_text())
+        expected = {item["path"] for field in ("skills", "optional_skills")
+                    for item in manifest[field]}
+        self.assertEqual(expected, paths, "the published command must include nested children")
+        optional = {item["path"] for item in manifest["optional_skills"]}
+        self.assertEqual(optional, {path for path in paths if path.startswith("optional-skills/")})
+
+    def test_real_team_exports_scope_nonbundled_root_helpers(self):
+        manifest = Manifest.load(ROOT)
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="adk-skill-scope-") as directory:
+            for target in ("claude-code", "opencode"):
+                with self.subTest(target=target):
+                    result = export_assets(manifest, target, Path(directory), ["team-core"])
+                    self.assertEqual("pass", result["status"])
+                    output = Path(result["output"])
+                    skill, = [path for path in output.rglob("SKILL.md")
+                              if path.parent.name == "adk-artifact-gating"]
+                    reference = skill.parent / "references/details.md"
+                    self.assertEqual(ARTIFACT.read_bytes(), reference.read_bytes())
+                    self.assertEqual([], list(output.rglob("check-adk-harden-readiness.sh")))
+                    text = reference.read_text()
+                    cross_repo = text.split("### 5.", 1)[1]
+                    helper_lines = [line for line in cross_repo.splitlines()
+                                    if "check-adk-harden-readiness.sh" in line]
+                    self.assertEqual(1, len(helper_lines))
+                    self.assertRegex(helper_lines[0], r"仅.{0,12}llm_agent Root")
+                    self.assertIn("已核验", cross_repo)
+                    self.assertIn("项目门禁", cross_repo)
+                    self.assertIn("BLOCKED", cross_repo)
+
+    def test_perf_generic_event_has_no_universal_llc_label(self):
+        text = (ROOT / "skills/adk-performance-profiling-embedded/SKILL.md").read_text()
+        # Linux v6.12 ARM PMUv3 maps generic CACHE_MISSES to L1D refill,
+        # so the former universal LLC label is invalid even for a valid count.
+        self.assertNotIn("LLC miss 用 perf stat -e cache-misses", text)
+        counter_line, = [line for line in text.splitlines() if "cache-misses" in line]
+        for evidence in ("CPU", "PMU", "内核", "LLC", "unavailable"):
+            self.assertIn(evidence, counter_line)
+        self.assertRegex(counter_line, r"cache-misses.{0,60}不默认等同 LLC")
+
+    def test_growth_metadata_limits_promotion_to_persistent_assets(self):
+        text = (ROOT / "skills/adk-engineering-growth-review/SKILL.md").read_text()
+        metadata = yaml.safe_load(text.split("---", 2)[1])
+        constraint, = [line for line in metadata["constraints"]
+                       if "trace-feedback-eval-handoff" in line]
+        self.assertTrue(constraint.startswith("仅"), constraint)
+        self.assertIn("晋级", constraint)
+        self.assertNotIn("改进建议进入执行层前必须", constraint)
+        workflow = text.split("## Workflow", 1)[1].split("## Output", 1)[0]
+        promotion, = [line for line in workflow.splitlines()
+                      if "trace-feedback-eval-handoff" in line]
+        self.assertRegex(promotion, r"^\d+\.\s*仅")
+        for asset in ("prompt", "Skill", "Workflow", "AGENTS", "记忆"):
+            self.assertIn(asset, constraint.split("晋级", 1)[0])
+            self.assertIn(asset, promotion.split("时输出", 1)[0])
+        self.assertIn("普通建议不需晋级", promotion)
+        self.assertIn("修改仍按原任务授权", promotion)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
